stories.title: Anthropic surpasses OpenAI to become most valuable AI startup
stories.author: Bolat14

gist.text: Anthropic raised $65B to reach ~$1T valuation, nearly tripling from February, driven by Claude's adoption and $47B annual revenue; both Anthropic and OpenAI are preparing IPOs.

stories.title: Proposed new US funding rules: We can cancel any grant at any time
stories.author: mhalle

gist.text: Grants could be cancelled anytime for vague "national interest" reasons; peer review becomes secondary to political appointees; bans proposed on culture war topics, international collaboration, and conference attendance.

stories.title: Leo's first encyclical attacks technological messianism
stories.author: 1vuio0pswjnm7

gist.text: Encyclical argues AI development lacks adequate safeguards and warns against treating technology as a path to human salvation; also covers journalism standards, diplomacy, slavery apology, and rejection of "just war" doctrine.

stories.title: Adding Linux support back for the BASIC (free) version of Vivado
stories.author: hasheddan

gist.text: AMD reverses planned removal of Linux support from free Vivado tier, keeping it available in 2026.1 release.

stories.title: Show HN: Helios – what plug-in solar could generate for any address in Britain
stories.author: ruaraidh

gist.text: Uses LIDAR building shadows and PVGIS modeling to estimate actual generation potential and 20-year savings for plug-in solar at your specific UK address, assuming 60% self-consumption.
